svg.title: Six generations of evaluation systems and the capabilities retained by each generation
svg.desc: A horizontal sequence from static benchmarks to persistent skill systems. A matrix below shows that each generation retains earlier evidence types and adds a new component: versioned graders, trajectories, task-world state, skill lineage, and persistent knowledge with library health.
svg.text: Evaluation evolved by adding evidence—not by discarding it
Each generation changes the unit of observation and keeps the controls that still matter.
Amber adds a new evidence component; teal retains it in every later generation.
